title: a love letter to @John Proctor Is The Villain & @tyler conroy 💜🎧🪩 #th...
transcript: Sometimes you see a Broadway play and just have to dance your heart out in the middle of Times Square. This is Tyler, and today is his birthday. Tyler and I didn't meet until we were in our 30s, which is wild because he is such an important friend to me. Just joyful and kind and wonderful in every single way. So obviously we had to go all out to celebrate his birth birthday. And no better way than seeing a new Broadway play, which is one of our favorite things to do. And that show had to be John Proctor is the villain. On the surface, this is a show about high school students studying the Crucible. Really, it's a coming of age play about reclaiming your story and the deep healing power of friendship. It's also full of fun references and gasp worthy moments. I laughed a lot, and I cried even more. I was an absolute wreck. But I pulled it together because this was John Proctor's the Villain Spirit Week. And after the show, we got to go to a silent disco in Schubert Alley. I really didn't know what to expect, but it was so much fun. And we were literally dancing as the actors were coming out to do the stage door. It was so silly, but we were having the best time. That is literally Sadie Sink. We danced to Taylor Swift and Beyonce and Robin and Carly Rae Jepsen and, of course, Lauren You gotta see the show to know why. And the cast even joined in. I'm sure to bystanders we look ridiculous, but I did not care. Dancing it out is the only way to respond to John Proctor is the villain. And the best way to celebrate. Tyler! Happy birthday, friend. I love you so much.
